description: The cmp module with invalid settings (SID_MODULE_CONFIG={"cmp":{"didomi":{}}}, a CMP it doesn't read): it fails closed, so storage is denied (reason cmp: error) and existing ID cookies are deleted on every request, with or without GDPR, and /v1 reports the module as an error.

cases.name: /sync is denied and deletes the ID
/v1 reports the module as an error
